mandatory_constraint: AutoGPT SHALL NOT become an FA3 identity, authentication, authorization, secrets, MCP/capability-gateway, model-routing, durable-workflow, evidence/provenance, network-egress, host-resource, developer-execution, artifact-trust or canonical-registry authority.

rules.name: AUTOGPT_TYPED_NODE_CONTRACT_REQUIRED
rules.requirement: Executable workflow nodes MUST declare typed input and output schemas independent of UI or provider syntax.
rules.enforcement: Executable regression and canonical reference checks MUST fail closed on violation.

rules.name: AUTOGPT_EXPLICIT_DELEGATED_EXECUTION_CONTEXT_REQUIRED
rules.requirement: Every material node execution MUST carry explicit caller identity, delegation identity, workflow-run identity, node identity, capability scope and policy decision context.
rules.enforcement: Executable regression and canonical reference checks MUST fail closed on violation.

rules.name: AUTOGPT_GRAPH_AUTH_NOT_TRANSITIVE_NODE_AUTH
rules.requirement: Authorization to possess or execute a graph MUST NOT transitively authorize every node or capability referenced by that graph.
rules.enforcement: Executable regression and canonical reference checks MUST fail closed on violation.

rules.name: AUTOGPT_DELEGATED_CAPABILITY_NARROWING_REQUIRED
rules.requirement: Delegated child-agent or expert capability scope MUST be a subset of the delegating principal's effective scope.
rules.enforcement: Executable regression and canonical reference checks MUST fail closed on violation.

rules.name: AUTOGPT_CREDENTIAL_SCOPE_MONOTONIC_NARROWING
rules.requirement: Credential visibility MUST narrow monotonically from workflow to node to capability to provider.
rules.enforcement: Executable regression and canonical reference checks MUST fail closed on violation.

rules.name: AUTOGPT_VALIDATE_BEFORE_PERSIST_ACTIVATE
rules.requirement: Graph schema, credential/lifecycle and policy validation MUST complete before persistence or activation; failure is fail-closed.
rules.enforcement: Executable regression and canonical reference checks MUST fail closed on violation.

rules.name: AUTOGPT_TRIGGER_SCHEDULE_NOT_AUTHORITY
rules.requirement: A webhook, schedule or trigger only requests execution and MUST NOT constitute authorization or capability admission.
rules.enforcement: Executable regression and canonical reference checks MUST fail closed on violation.

rules.name: AUTOGPT_MODEL_CATALOG_NOT_ROUTER_AUTHORITY
rules.requirement: AutoGPT's model catalog is a provider projection only; FA3 model/provider selection remains FA3-AUTH-MODEL-ROUTER-001 authority.
rules.enforcement: Executable regression and canonical reference checks MUST fail closed on violation.

rules.name: AUTOGPT_CREDENTIAL_STORE_NOT_SECRETS_AUTHORITY
rules.requirement: AutoGPT credential storage MUST NOT become the FA3 secrets authority; provider credentials are externally admitted and scoped.
rules.enforcement: Executable regression and canonical reference checks MUST fail closed on violation.

rules.name: AUTOGPT_EXECUTOR_NOT_HOST_OR_DEVELOPER_AUTHORITY
rules.requirement: AutoGPT executors and containers are execution mechanisms only and MUST NOT replace Host Resource Broker or developer-execution authority.
rules.enforcement: Executable regression and canonical reference checks MUST fail closed on violation.

rules.name: AUTOGPT_MARKETPLACE_LIBRARY_NOT_PRODUCTION_ADMISSION
rules.requirement: Marketplace or library adoption, popularity or import MUST NOT constitute artifact trust, capability admission or production promotion.
rules.enforcement: Executable regression and canonical reference checks MUST fail closed on violation.

rules.name: AUTOGPT_EXECUTION_EVIDENCE_ATTRIBUTABLE
rules.requirement: Every material node execution MUST emit attributable evidence binding caller, delegation, workflow, graph version, node, capability, provider, policy decision, input/output digests and result.
rules.enforcement: Executable regression and canonical reference checks MUST fail closed on violation.

rules.name: AUTOGPT_INTEGRATION_BOUNDARIES_PRESERVED
rules.requirement: AutoGPT integrations MUST remain behind FA3 MCP/tool mediation, network-egress and secrets boundaries.
rules.enforcement: Executable regression and canonical reference checks MUST fail closed on violation.

rules.name: AUTOGPT_IMMUTABLE_RUNTIME_REFERENCE_REQUIRED
rules.requirement: Production runtime identity MUST be an immutable full commit or artifact; floating master/dev/latest and release tags without commit binding are not promotion evidence.
rules.enforcement: Executable regression and canonical reference checks MUST fail closed on violation.

rules.name: AUTOGPT_LICENSE_BOUNDARY_ADMISSION_REQUIRED
rules.requirement: Runtime/code use MUST respect the component license boundary: autogpt_platform requires explicit PolyForm Shield admission; MIT status of Classic does not erase that boundary.
rules.enforcement: Executable regression and canonical reference checks MUST fail closed on violation.

rules.name: AUTOGPT_DISABLED_PROVIDER_ZERO_NEAR_ZERO_RUNTIME_COST
rules.requirement: When disabled/reference-only, AutoGPT MUST have no resident provider process, active poller, network session or host-resource lease.
rules.enforcement: Executable regression and canonical reference checks MUST fail closed on violation.

rules.name: AUTOGPT_PROVIDER_NOT_ARCHITECTURAL_AUTHORITY
rules.requirement: FA3-PROVIDER-AUTOGPT-001 remains optional, non-root, non-authoritative, adds no capability and preserves the canonical capability count of 143.
rules.enforcement: Executable regression and canonical reference checks MUST fail closed on violation.
